rawContent: @Alyssa_Milano @johnpavlovitz Most women take a long time (if ever) to shine the light on the abuse they’ve suffered. Ford is knowingly standing as a shield in front of all of us KNOWING that the political machine will do its best to destroy her. Thanks is not enough #metoo

@MamaShutterBug @AnnTruwe It was never your fault Katie... know that you are wholly loved and perfect for who you are... scars and all. Many of us know what the inside of that particular dark well looks like. I’ll hold your hand. #metoo #IStandWithChristineBlaseyFord

@meghanstout @GlennonDoyle Amen... I really thought I was ok... that my #metoo wasn’t that bad, that I was whole and fine and just angry for my sisters.. after this week I found depths of scarring and pain and rage I didn’t even know existed 🤬
